# Physical Runtime Guide

PAIS is a Physical Node Contract. It keeps `semantic_type`, `unit`, `frame`, `freshness`, `authority`, `preconditions`, `operation_id`, error domains, and audit links explicit because a real action can continue after a timeout.

## One-page Mental Map
The consumer discovers a node, reads its contract, observes facts, validates a typed request, and reconciles the outcome.

## Design Spine
Explicit facts; separated intent; deterministic execution; capability scope; bounded responsibility.

## Runtime
The example retains code, state transitions, failure evidence, and conformance implications. It is not simplified into a summary.
